title: Recitation of Psalms
summary: Mahalia recites Psalm passages; the transcript has a long run of garbled repeated words.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: The days of our years are three scores in ten. And if by reason of strength they be four years. Yet is their strength labor and sorrow. For it is soon cut off and we fly away. Who knoweth the power of thine angry? Even according to thy fears, so is thy wrath. So teach us to number our days. That we may apply our hearts unto wisdom. Return, O Lord, hallow. And let it repent thee concerning thy servant. O satisfy us early with thy mercy. That we may rejoice and be glad all our days. Make us glad according to the days wherein thou hast afflicted us. And the years wherein we have seen evil. Let thy work of thy servant. Let thy glory unto thy children. And let the beauty of the Lord our God be upon us. And establish thy work of our hands upon us. Yea, the work of our hands establish it. Let dear which made the heavens and earth. He will not suffer thy foot to be moved. He that keepeth thee will not slumber. Behold, he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep. The Lord is thy keeper. The Lord is thy shed upon thy right hand. The sun shall not smite thee by day nor the moon by night. The Lord shall preserve thee from all evil. He shall preserve thy soul. The Lord shall preserve thy out going and thy coming in from this time forth and forevermore. The Lord shall preserve thy fear. The Lord is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid? When the weakest, even my enemies and my foes shall come upon me to eat up my flesh, they shall stumble and fall. though an host should encamp against me, though an host should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear. Though wars should rise against me, in this will I be confident. one thing have I desire of the Lord, and that will I seek at, that I may dwell in the house of the Lord all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the Lord, and to inquire in his temple. For in the time of trouble, he shall hide me in his grave. and in his secret tabernacle, he shall hide me. He shall set me upon a rock. And now shall my head be lifted up above my enemies, around about me. Therefore, will I offer in this tabernacle fact of joy. I will sing, yea, I will sing praises unto the Lord. Hear, O Lord, when I cry with my voice. And have mercy also upon me, and answer me. When thou sayest, seek ye my face, my heart said unto thee, Thou face, Lord, will I seek. Hide not thy face far from me. Put not thy servant away in anger. Thou hast been my help. Leave me not, neither forsake me. O Lord, of my salvation, when my father and my mother forsake me, then the Lord will take me up. Teach me thy way, O Lord, and lead me in a plain path because of my enemies. Deliver me not over unto the will of my enemies, for false witness rises against me. And such as breath out cruelty, I had fainted unless I had believed to see the goodness of the Lord in the Lamb's living. Wait on the Lord and be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thy heart. Wait, I say, on the Lord.
